name: unifi
title: UniFi
description: Monitor and control UniFi Network, Protect, and cloud services
author: lewj

commands.name: select-site
commands.title: Select Site
commands.description: Choose the Network site used by commands and AI tools

commands.name: network-overview
commands.title: UniFi Overview
commands.description: See current Network and Protect health, inventory, updates, and problems

commands.name: unifi-health-menu
commands.title: UniFi Health in Menu Bar
commands.description: Keep Network and Protect health visible in the macOS menu bar

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Dashboard
commands.description: Open the selected local or cloud UniFi console

commands.name: view-devices
commands.title: Search Devices
commands.description: Search devices, inspect ports and radios, view live stats, and restart hardware

commands.name: view-clients
commands.title: Search Clients
commands.description: Search connected wired, wireless, VPN, and Teleport clients

commands.name: browse-network
commands.title: Browse Network Configuration
commands.description: Browse documented Network resources such as networks, Wi-Fi, firewall, switching, DNS, and VPN

commands.name: browse-protect
commands.title: Protect Cameras and Devices
commands.description: Browse Protect cameras, sensors, lights, alarms, viewers, and other devices

commands.name: browse-platform
commands.title: Browse UniFi Platform
commands.description: Browse Site Manager and optional Mobility, InnerSpace, and Carrier resources

tools.name: get-unifi-health
tools.title: Get UniFi Health
tools.description: Get a concise combined health check for the selected UniFi Network site and UniFi Protect.

tools.name: get-network-overview
tools.title: Get Network Overview
tools.description: Get current device, client, network, Wi-Fi, WAN, and firewall status for a UniFi Network site.

tools.name: search-unifi
tools.title: Search UniFi
tools.description: Search the selected UniFi Network site and UniFi Protect devices by name, IP, MAC address, model, type, or ID.

tools.name: get-protect-overview
tools.title: Get Protect Overview
tools.description: Get current UniFi Protect NVR, camera, sensor, alarm, light, viewer, and device status.

tools.name: get-unifi-resources
tools.title: Get UniFi Resources
tools.description: Read a documented resource collection from Network, Protect, Site Manager, Mobility, InnerSpace, or Carrier Fabric.

tools.name: restart-network-device
tools.title: Restart Network Device
tools.description: Restart an adopted UniFi Network device after showing the user a confirmation.

tools.name: control-protect-device
tools.title: Control Protect Device
tools.description: Run a supported Protect siren, PTZ, relay, alarm hub, or arm action after showing the user a confirmation.

preferences.name: connectionMode
preferences.title: Connection
preferences.description: Connect directly to a local console or through the UniFi Site Manager Cloud Connector.

preferences.name: controllerUrl
preferences.description: UniFi console IP address or URL, for example https://192.168.1.1. Used for Local Console mode.
preferences.title: Console IP or URL

preferences.name: consoleId
preferences.description: Console ID from Site Manager. Required for Cloud Connector Network, Protect, or InnerSpace calls.
preferences.title: Cloud Console ID

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: UniFi API Key
preferences.description: API key created in UniFi Site Manager or the local console. Raycast stores password preferences securely.

preferences.name: allowSelfSignedCertificate
preferences.title: Certificate Verification
preferences.description: Local Console only. Disables TLS certificate verification for consoles that use UniFi's default self-signed certificate.
preferences.label: Allow a self-signed console certificate (not recommended)

preferences.name: dateFormat
preferences.title: Date Format
preferences.description: The format to display dates in

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
